items.title_en: Chennai Woman With ₹1.05 Crore Portfolio Asks If She Can Quit Work: 'I Want To Retire At 40-42'
items.title_zh: 拥有 10.5 亿卢比投资组合的钦奈女士询问是否可以辞职：“我想在 40-42 岁退休”
items.summary_en: A 32-year-old Chennai woman with a Rs 1.05 crore investment portfolio wants to retire by 40-42. Her savings strategy has sparked debate online
